title: Lumi hình thái 3 · ride
style: Static locked camera, three-quarter view facing screen-right, matching the reference, the whole body, weapon and shield always inside the frame with a margin, the face visible, the flat solid green background never changes. segments.name: A
segments.prompt: A chibi blonde star sorceress floating in the air, long golden hair, amber eyes, a white and purple witch hat crowned with golden stars and a crescent moon, small golden wings, a white, gold and purple star gown with a long cape, white armoured boots, holding a tall golden spear-staff topped with a star inside golden orbit rings in her right hand, rides her spear-staff through the air like a broom toward screen-right, sitting on it, her long hair, cape and hat streaming back in the wind, bobbing slightly; she stays on the same spot and returns to the pose of the last frame. She keeps floating in the air on the same spot, feet off the ground, without drifting; no turning or scale change. Arms, shoulders and torso drive the action; hair, cloth and cape follow with natural overlapping motion. Preserve her identity, costume, proportions and the single rigid staff, always drawn whole and clearly visible. No added effects, aura, glow, dust or particles.
